news.text: 🙄 "The #Juventus management has been very active making calls during the day to evaluate new alternatives for the goal, after a setback was confirmed on their main objective.​The Zion #Suzuki deal stalled, as the transfer was personally blocked by #LuisEnrique.​Faced with the collapse of the #Suzuki option, #Juve contacted the agent Jorge Mendes to inquire about the Brazilian goalkeeper and ex #ManchesterCity, #EdersonMoraes.He is a goalkeeper that fits the profile in terms of personality and experience that coach #Spalletti is looking for.His ability to play with his feet, perfected during his years under Pep #Guardiola, is a highly valued factor.We will have to wait and see if #Juve's inte

🚨 "I was told that, as of today, #Juventus is thinking more about a temporary solution for the goalkeeper position.On loan, I don't see many names.I believe, based on how it was explained to me by those close to #Juve, that all these €20-25M profiles (the names rumored out there) are not convincing.That is to say, today #Juve, in my opinion, is not convinced about signing any player for €20-25M and saying 'He is the goalkeeper of the future'. That is how I interpreted it."[@romeoagresti on the YouTube channel of @ilbianconerocom via @PuebloJ]

GJustjuve .@ACMonza dreams of #DiGregorio's return from @juventusfc [Di Marzio] https://t.me/GJustjuve/71170🔙 #Monza dreams of Michele #DiGregorio's return. The idea is to bring the #Juventus goalkeeper back to Brianza using the loan formula.For #DiGregorio, it would be a return to a special place: joining #Monza in the summer of 2020, he spent four years in biancorosso, collecting 144 appearances and contributing to the club's first historic promotion to Serie A, in 2022.It was precisely with #Monza that he also reached his highest individual point, being elected the best goalkeeper in Serie A for the 2023/24 season. Now #Monza dreams of embracing him once again.[Di Marzio via @AverageJuven

😭 "The agent had commented on having interest from abroad for Michele #DiGregorio, but since then these tracks have fallen apart.One was #Arsenal in a swap deal where #Juventus was offered Kepa #Arrizabalaga for #DiGregorio who would become the second-choice goalkeeper, but the Spaniard did not convince the bianconero club.The other was #AstonVilla in case #Dibu went to war with the club to leave, they considered replacing him with the Italian from #Juve, but in the end the Argentine didn't leave.As for the rumor linking him to #Torino, no confirmations have been found from the club or from the goalkeeper's entourage.At this moment, there are no teams pursuing the goalkeeper of la Vecchia Si

🔛🧤 "While #Juventus accelerates for the new goalkeeper, no concrete offers are arriving for #DiGregorio. The inquiries from #Marseille and #Valencia have remained simple requests for information and, for now, have not transformed into negotiations, not even for a loan with an option to buy. Thus, the search for the new goalkeeper continues without waiting for his exit. His future, however, seems far from Turin: the decision has now been made, work just needs to be done so that an offer arrives.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

😲 "In January 2026, #Juventus had finalized the signing of Mauro #Icardi, everything was done with the player and the club, but Luciano #Spalletti had a conversation with the #Juve management and vetoed the arrival of the Argentine with arguments that the club accepted."[@MomblanOfficial on @juventibus via @PuebloJ]
#Lucumí's medical examination with @JuventusFC will be on Sunday. The deal, as reported, will be around 20 million euros plus bonuses. @SkySport[Di Marzio]

👀 "The club that would have entered the race recently for Guglielmo #Vicario is #OlympiqueMarseille.But the French club would be interested in the Italian under the same formula that #Juventus is seeking: loan without an obligation to buy."[@MomblanOfficial on @juventibus via @PuebloJ]

#Juve evaluates the stay of Federico #Gatti.The only proposal that arrived (the one on loan with an option to buy from #Napoli) was not satisfactory and only a 25mln offer can change their mind.[Mirko Di Natale]

👀 "Even with what happened with #Suzuki and the resurgence of #Juventus's link with Guglielmo #Vicario, #Spalletti's veto over the Italian goalkeeper is still there.It remains to be understood if #Juve will push for the #Tottenham goalkeeper despite the bianconero coach's dislike and the fact that #Vicario has another offer."[@MomblanOfficial on @juventibus via @PuebloJ]

🚑 Work continues separately for #Thuram and #Ekhator: barring surprises, they will not participate in the family friendly match on Monday.#Spalletti's hope is to have them available again for the match against #Frosinone.[@tuttosport via @PuebloJ]

🧱🆙 #Cabal is ready to wear the #Bologna shirt: the parties are closer. For the full-back, it is heading toward an option to buy. While waiting for #Lucumí, #Juventus must, however, still make a sale. For #Bremer, no concrete offers have come, while for Lloyd #Kelly as well there have been no substantial steps forward. For this reason, the name on the way out is still #Gatti: in recent hours, interest has arrived from #HullCity and mainly #Marseille.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

‼️EXCL.#Atalanta is thinking about Nico #Gonzalez. This could be a track to follow from now until the end of the mercato, in addition to the one already present from #Atleti. At the moment, #Juventus is only evaluating permanent offers or those with an obligation to buy, no loans.[Mirko Di Natale]
🚨⚪️⚫️ Understand Jhon Lucumì will fly to Turin tomorrow, Saturday to complete his medical at Juventus.Deal agreed with Bologna last night and documents exchange underway. 🇨🇴[Fabrizio Romano]
